Author: linusfr
Name: Wayfinder
Punchline: Adds a fuzzy search box to the Duty Finder and the Teleport window.
Description: Docks a search field under the game's own Duty Finder and Teleport windows. Type part of a name — "aurum", "arum", "vale", "alex", "radz" — and pick from ranked results; the game's own window then does the selecting, queueing and teleporting exactly as if you had clicked the row yourself. Search and filter only: no automation, no queueing for you, no bypassing unlocks, level requirements or gil costs.
